dependencyRationale: The visible Trays category is produced by persisted batch terminal state, carried through ScreenSnapshot and the component Store, and rendered by shared Compose; tests and localized resources are transitive inputs.
fallbackReason: The current shared modules expose a generic screen model rather than a dedicated Trays module, so the complete component/data/compose feature paths are fingerprinted.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0; Android SDK 37
